name: gradient-swoop
description: An npm package for animated gradient swoop backgrounds.
longDesc: gradient-swoop is an npm package that renders a smooth, animated gradient ribbon using a cubic Bézier curve rendered on canvas. It uses ordered strip tessellation along the curve with per-strip linear gradients and a film grain overlay for texture. Comes with a live playground so you can tweak colors, thickness, and animation speed in real time.

name: Echo
description: AI-powered review intelligence for an restaurant, café, or venue.
longDesc: Echo is a full-stack web app that transforms public reviews into actionable insights about any place. Search any restaurant, hotel, or venue and get Claude's distilled take, sentiment scoring with trend analysis, topic breakdowns by mention frequency, visit timing recommendations, vibe and tone profiling, and insider tips — all without reading a single review. Built with React, Node.js, and the Anthropic and Google Places APIs.

name: Databuddy
description: Designed and built feature pages for Databuddy's marketing site.
longDesc: Databuddy is an analytics platform for developers and indie makers. I designed and built their marketing site's feature pages in Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS — including interactive demos that let visitors experience the product before signing up. Focused on clear visual hierarchy and strong communication of the product's value.

name: Self-Driving Agent from Scratch
description: Trained a DQN agent to drive using only raw pixels as input.
longDesc: This project implements a Deep Q-Network agent from scratch using PyTorch to solve the CarRacing-v3 environment from Gymnasium. The agent learns entirely from raw pixel input, receiving 96x96 RGB frames and deciding when to steer, accelerate, or brake. The implementation includes a CNN architecture that processes 4 stacked gray scale frames to detect motion, an experience replay buffer to break correlation in training data, a target network for stable Q-value estimation, and epsilon-greedy exploration that decays over time. Key challenges included frame preprocessing (cropping, gray scale conversion, normalization), tuning hyperparameters like learning rate and epsilon decay, and implementing checkpoint saving to resume training across sessions. The project demonstrates understanding of core RL concepts including the Bellman equation, Q-learning, and the exploration-exploitation tradeoff.
